title: Sweet Corn and Poblano Rice
description: Jasmine rice steams with sweet corn and mild roasted poblano.

steps.title: Set the heat
steps.text: Use the lidded HexClad wok on a medium burner.

steps.title: Build flavor
steps.text: Warm {oil}; stir in {ricefl} and {poblano} for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Cook gently
steps.text: Add {broth} and {corn}, bring to a simmer, cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Rest off heat for 10 minutes with the lid closed, then fluff.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers and refrigerate up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze up to 1 month; grains and vegetables soften slightly. Fridge reheat: stir with a spoonful of water over low heat until 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw in the fridge and warm by the same method. Dairy swap: use unsalted plant butter or dairy-free cheese as applicable. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 247 kcal, 5.9 g protein, 47.8 g total carbohydrate, 3.9 g fat, 1.8 g fiber, 23 mg sodium.
